newsitem.title: UK: UK construction workload rose in Q4 - study.
newsitem.headline: UK construction workload rose in Q4 - study.

text.p: Britain's construction industry last quarter reached its highest workload level since 1993 and could rise further, the Royal Institution of Chartered Surveyors said on Friday.
A study by the chartered surveyors said construction workload, in terms of the value of orders, rose by 2.4 percent in the fourth quarter of 1996 versus the third quarter.
When compared with the year-earlier period, fourth quarter workload grew by 4.0 percent.
The group declined to disclose the estimated value of orders in the industry.

"The progress made by the construction industry over the last 12 months is nothing short of remarkable. With conditions in place for sustained growth, there is good reason for optimism," it said in a statement.
It added the proportion of chartered surveyors anticipating increased levels over the next 12 months was at its most positive for four years.
